cover.sub: Stay, build your own academy, or both

title: Pick by *what you want to own*
verdict.sub: There is no single best path. Start from what you want next.

rows.need: You want your own app, brand and student list
rows.why: AllCoaching: own domain and Android app (iOS on Pro or yearly) on every plan, 7-day free trial

rows.need: You want a large audience under a known brand
rows.why: Reach comes with the brand; educator terms are not published on its website

rows.need: You want reach now and your own name too
rows.why: Teach on the platform and build your academy on the side, if your agreement allows

rows.need: You mainly want to grow an audience first
rows.why: Free to start; add your own academy when viewers ask how to buy

title: Start *without leaving first*
switch.sub: Build on the side, if your agreement allows
steps: Check exclusivity and content clauses first
Share your link on YouTube and WhatsApp
Keep both, or move fully when ready

checks: Your own Android app (iOS on Pro or yearly)
Tests and notes in one place
